integrity: The primary preprint was checked at the definition of bounded Ramsey's theorem and at Theorem 1.7. The added implication is the uniform identity-on-colorings reduction from the bounded pairs problem to ordinary Ramsey's theorem for pairs.
scientific_limitations: The result excludes only reductions using a fixed finite number of lower-arity bounded-Ramsey calls. It does not settle unrestricted omega-reducibility and does not add a new hyperimmunity construction.
title: Finite-use arity separation in bounded Ramsey theory
